Regional Privacy Legislation 2024
Approved 2024 Draft
Version 2024
Prepared for regional legislative review

Slide 2: Data minimization amendment
Require agencies and contractors to limit collection of personal data to what is strictly necessary for a stated statutory purpose.

Slide 3: Cross-border transfer safeguard
Mandate transfer impact assessments and equivalent protection clauses before transferring resident data outside the region.

Slide 4: Breach notification timetable
Shorten mandatory breach notification to 72 hours after confirmation of a material incident.

Slide 5: Children's data protections
Require opt-in consent for processing personal data of minors under 16 and prohibit targeted advertising to minors.

Slide 6: Enforcement and penalties
Increase maximum administrative penalties to 4% of annual regional turnover for severe or repeated violations.
